title: Kinetics of the Persulfate-Iodide Clock Reaction
description: Measurement of initial reaction rates and determination of rate law orders (m, n) for persulfate oxidation of iodide ions.
steps: Prepare Reaction Mixture A (KI + Na2S2O3 + starch + deionized water).
Combine solutions rapidly and initiate digital chronometer simultaneously.
Swirl continuously until instantaneous sudden transition to deep triiodide-starch blue.
Record elapsed time delta_t and compute reaction velocity rate = delta[S2O8^2-] / delta_t.
Vary concentrations to extract reaction order with respect to each reactant.
safety: Persulfate is an oxidizer. Avoid inhalation of dust and contact with organic reducing agents.
